messages:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a lightweight RBAC smoke scan across prod/org yesterday evening and found ~48 principals with admin/owner bindings that look unused or suspicious. posting summary + ask for volunteers to triage.

maria: high-level: most noise is from service accounts with no recent tokens and a few cross-account roles created last year. also a handful of human admins that haven't logged in >180 days.

maria: sample query I ran (bigtable export):
```sql
SELECT principal, role, last_auth, last_key_rotation
FROM iam_bindings
WHERE role LIKE '%owner%' OR role LIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY last_auth NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;
```

alex: ok I can take a chunk — happy to start with svc-accs. do we have an approval path for short-lived perms if a team needs fast reinstatement? :+1:

maria: @alex tx — yes, use the emergency-iam runbook (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/emergency-iam) and tag `#eng-oncall` + `security-oncall`. quick reinstates require a JIRA with owner and TTL <48h.

tj: quick note — a lot of the flagged entries are old cross-account links to partner projects. we should confirm whether owners are still valid before pruning. i can open a calendar invite to contact owners in bulk.

tj: top offenders I saw in the CSV: svc-redwood-deploy, build-bot-sa, analytics-reader-sa, partner-sync-sa. many have keys older than 400 days.

infra-bot: automated-scan:rbac_v1 completed. findings=48; high=5; medium=14; info=29. ticket created: SEC-2341. (This is an automated message)

sara: question on KMS — some of these svc accounts have direct KMS grants to customer CMKs. before we remove a binding we should run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` / `aws kms get-key-policy` to confirm no explicit grant. anyone want to own KMS checks?

alex: I can handle the svc-account -> kms mapping. will run the key policy checks and comment on SEC-2341. plan: list all principals with binding, then map to key grants.

jen: small ask from product: for any human admin prune, please send a quick email to the team slack alias and cc security. we want to avoid accidental outages for integrated dashboards. also prefer canary removals where possible.

ops-bot: created: incident/maint SEC-2341-01 "RBAC cleanup wave 1" assigned to @maria, due: 2026-04-02. updates will be posted to #incidents.

maria: plan of attack: 1) @alex runs svc-account KMS mapping & posts results in SEC-2341. 2) @tj will reach out to owners for the partner cross-accounts (template in runbook). 3) @sara and infra will validate any CMK grants. 4) human admin stale list -> env leads for reauth or removal.

maria: please add a short justification comment in the IAM console or the ticket before removing. take screenshots if needed. target: complete initial pass by EOD Thu (48h). ping me if you need escalation.

alex: acked, will start on KMS mapping now and post an interim CSV.

tj: will take the partner contacts, sending invites this afternoon.

sara: will collate KMS grant findings and flag any keys that require a scheduled regrant vs prune.

maria: thanks everyone. will run the next smoke scan after wave 1 and compare diffs. :white_check_mark:
